actions.text: Referred to the House Committee on Education and Workforce.

dimensions.assessment: Directly impacts eligible partnerships consisting of educational institutions, child care providers, and students training for the early childhood workforce.
dimensions.evidence: award grants, on a competitive basis, to eligible partnerships for the purpose of establishing, supporting, or expanding career and technical education

dimensions.assessment: Provides funding for educational materials, work-based learning, recruitment, and wrap-around student supports such as financial assistance or child care.
dimensions.evidence: providing academic and nonacademic wrap-around supports and services, including advising, tutoring, test preparation, child care assistance

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a multi-year competitive grant program with up to 5-year grants and possible 2-year extensions, though specific funding dollar authorizations are omitted.
dimensions.evidence: a grant awarded under this section may not exceed a 5-year grant period.

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a new coordinated federal grant program requiring application criteria, priority distributions, and independent evaluations.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary, in coordination with the Secretary of Health and Human Services, shall award grants

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes individual grants for up to five years with potential two-year extensions.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary may extend the grant period for an eligible partnership for not more than 1 additional 2-year period

missing_information: Total authorized appropriation amounts for the grant program
importance_detail.rationale: Creates a competitive federal grant program administered by the Department of Education and HHS to establish and expand career and technical education programs in early childhood education over multi-year periods.
